turns.question: Over the six weeks from Monday 17 August to Sunday 27 September 2026, which day of the week brought in the most revenue, and how much?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no day-of-week grain, so it cannot total revenue by weekday; the closest metric is Revenue (EUR), which it gives by day, and the highest single day in 17 August to 27 September 2026 was 20 September 2026 at 531.50 EUR, not a weekday total. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
